high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from the ESPNcricinfo app, displaying the result of the 4th Test match between India and England at The Oval, held from September 2 to 6, 2021, during the India tour of England. The match summary indicates that India won by 157 runs with a final score of 191 & 466 against England's 290 & 210. The top section of the screen shows the match details: India scored 191 and 466. England scored 290
